roleNote: An example of what you can build from kit components. Start from it, change it, or ignore it; layout is your choice. Follow `must` (kit look and accessibility); `defaults` are this example's suggestions, change any of them.
copyNote: Not exported from agentic-ds-kit. add copies the source into your app (components/patterns/assistant-workspace/) with this contract beside it. You own the copy: replace the demo data, rearrange or drop sections, and keep the `must` lines.
intent: Workspace with two-column InsightCards and an inline Chat rail.
must: Use kit components from agentic-ds-kit for anything the kit has; no local cousins (tables, dialogs, rows, rules, charts)
Semantic tokens only (agentic-ds-kit/tokens.css); no raw hex, no primitive --color-* ramps
At most one variant="primary" Button per view: with Chat open its Send is the primary, so InsightCards drop primaryAction
Do not restyle kit components; change them through their props, slots, and tokens

Render inside a main landmark (wrap the pattern, or your page content, in <main>); header and nav chrome, if any, use AppHeader / SideNav (or other header / nav landmarks) and nav stays reachable on small screens
defaults: Chat sits inline in a rail beside the content, not in a Modal
layout-split lays the InsightCards out in two columns
Chat uses radius none in the rail
Below 64rem (--grid-breakpoint-md) the rail stacks under the content (layout-workspace default) and the InsightCards go to one column

Below 64rem, Ask on an InsightCard scrolls the stacked rail into view (instantly under prefers-reduced-motion) and moves focus to it; wider, the rail is already beside the cards and focus stays on the card
